name: Master Carpenter Stig
title: Master of the Timberway
examine: Sawdust in the beard, a pencil behind each ear. He looks at you briefly, then at the nearest joint, longer.
lines: I hung the castle doors and built the moot dais. The King thanked me for the dais. The doors thank me every winter, which is worth more.
Measure twice, and measure it yourself the second time.
Mountain pine fights you for forty years and then behaves forever. Same as apprentices.
